title: Governed National Business Registry
description: Canonical organizations, brands, sites, establishments, services, relationships, and source assertions reconciled across authorized U.S. business data sources.

location_match_profile_contract.current_coordinates: geocode:{latitude,longitude}|null; point coordinate order is never inferred
location_match_profile_contract.postal_contract: zip_code and postal_code are the same exact ZIP5; zip4 is a separate exact four-digit-or-null value

legacy_read_only_compatibility.normalized_projection: geocode:{latitude,longitude}|null; immutable source bytes are not rewritten

spatial_zip_polygon_denominator.selection_scope: complete selected Census-published ZCTA5 polygon set pinned by release ID, manifest SHA-256, source layer, and vintage

usps_operational_zip_evidence.absence_effect: Does not block publication or use of the Census ZCTA5 spatial polygon denominator.

member_set_reconciliation.verification: Exact sorted ZIP5 member-set SHA-256 equality between the pinned USPS assignment artifact and registry rows marked listed; count equality alone is insufficient.
member_set_reconciliation.distribution: local-restricted aggregate counts and digests only; no USPS member list
separate_semantics: USPS assignment is not address deliverability
Census ZCTA is not USPS geometry

next_release_contract.normalized_us_postal_fields: zip_code and postal_code contain ZIP5 only; zip4 is a separate four-digit-or-null field
next_release_contract.migration_sequence: rebuild corrected source releases, then registry, entity resolution, benchmark, and coverage

publication_rule: No field is publishable without a source record, release, ingest run, transformation version, temporal scope, and policy profile.

current_release.scope_authority: The immutable release manifest is authoritative for complete source-specific coverage and limitations; this catalog stores exact headline totals only.

entity_resolution_capability.profile_cardinality: exactly one location match profile per matching-eligible physical-site/establishment pair; reporting-only location evidence is excluded from identity matching
entity_resolution_capability.identity_effect: Profiles are derived evidence only; they do not mutate provisional source entities or assertions.
